anchor: `Program-based` (through the specific intervention or cohort the study is about)
`Clinical` (through a health-care setting, or by diagnosis or treatment status)
`Targeted/specific` — the frame is restricted by something the study **imposed on top of its setting**
`Representative` — the source claims probability sampling, or claims the sample represents a defined population
Respondents were reached through their employer, their occupation, or a professional body
`Non-person unit` — each `id` is a stimulus, text, image, object, specimen or organisation
`Other` means outside all seven values, not undecided between two
`Physical health/functioning` covers bodily symptoms, functional capacity and disability
